lede: The biggest thing on the calendar this week is a public hearing at the San Miguel County BOCC on whether to waive land use fees for Mountain Village's affordable housing project in the Ilium Valley — a small procedural question that says a lot about how much the county is willing to put behind its housing commitments. The same day, Mountain Village opens its all-day 2027 budget work session, and the county's Planning Commission follows Wednesday with a joint BOCC work session on an Affordable Housing Code Update. SMART's board also meets to vote on amending the Gondola Project IGA for FY27 and kicks off budget talks for the $5.2M/year the authority collects in tax revenue.

notable.stake: Public hearing on waiving fees for Ilium Valley affordable housing project.
